label: August 24–30, 2026
intro: BICT Fest's thrilling final week — weekday shows continue, then the closing weekend August 29–30 is your last chance to catch international children's theatre at One Bangkok.

activities.title: BICT Fest 2026 — Closing Weekend (Last Chance!)
activities.date: Saturday–Sunday August 29–30 (final days of the festival)
activities.time: Various show times — see bictfest.com/2026/ for full programme
activities.location: One Bangkok Park + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre, Chulalongkorn Univ.
activities.price: Free programmes + ticketed shows via Eventpop
activities.why: Last weekend of BICT Fest's 10th anniversary edition. If you haven't caught any shows yet, this is your absolute final chance. 11 participatory performances from 9 countries — interactive, immersive, and designed for kids like Thor. Closing-weekend energy is electric.
activities.tip: Any remaining free programme spots will be first-come-first-served at the door. Arrive early. Paid ticketed shows on Eventpop — check what's left and book before Saturday morning.

activities.title: BICT Fest 2026 — Weekday Shows
activities.time: Various show times — see bictfest.com/2026/ for schedule
activities.location: One Bangkok Park + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre, Chulalongkorn Univ.
activities.price: Free programmes + ticketed shows via Eventpop
activities.why: Weekday shows at BICT Fest are often less crowded, making for a more intimate experience. Thor gets more direct interaction with the performers. International artists from South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Belgium, France, UK, Singapore, Indonesia, and Thailand.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings tend to have smaller audiences — you'll often get better spots and more artist interaction. Check the schedule at bictfest.com/2026/ for which shows run on which days.

activities.title: Bean to Bar Chocolate Workshop — Make Your Own Chocolate
activities.date: Book for Saturday or Sunday August 29–30
activities.location: Bangkok (central area — check Tripadvisor or Klook for exact venue)
activities.price: Check Tripadvisor or Klook for current pricing
activities.why: Thor loved making chocolate! Bean to Bar workshops let kids see the whole process from cacao bean to finished chocolate bar — mixing, moulding, and tasting. Hands-on making + a delicious result he can bring home.
activities.tip: Book well in advance as weekend sessions fill up. A morning chocolate workshop + afternoon BICT Fest closing show is the ultimate last-weekend double.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Pottery Workshop
activities.date: Saturday or Sunday August 29–30 — book at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.why: If chocolate-making is booked out, ClassBento's kids' ceramic sessions are equally hands-on. Thor pinches, rolls, and sculpts his own piece — and gets to take it home after firing.
activities.tip: Book 2–3 days ahead. Check both classbento.co.th and their Facebook page for any last-minute spots.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Sessions
activities.location: Sub-Zero Sukhumvit-Ekkamai (BTS Ekkamai) or Sub-Zero Mega Bangna
activities.price: ~200 THB adults / 100 THB children; 90-min ~260 THB incl. skates & helmet
activities.why: Between BICT Fest shows, cool off at Sub-Zero. Quiet weekday sessions give Thor more ice space to practise — great for building his skating confidence.
activities.tip: Monday and Tuesday tend to be the quietest days at the rink.
